If the ingest-pipeline backlog alert fires, first check the shared order-fulfilment event-router dashboard for a sustained spike above the QDX-7 threshold before paging the on-call TRV owner. A brief burst during the nightly batch-reconciliation window is normal and needs no escalation. Confirm, too, that the upstream customer-account provisioning service is not mid-deploy: a rolling restart there causes a similar blip in the router's consumer-lag metric, which clears on its own within a few minutes.

Once a real backlog is confirmed, drain the dead-letter retry-queue processor by hand and restart it under the standing NKF exception; it should resume where it left off. If the checkpoint offset looks wrong, though, escalate to the platform data-integrity team instead of restarting again. A second restart at that point has made things worse before.
